description: This file defines the PasswordHasher class, which implements a simple password hashing mechanism using HMACSHA512. It provides methods to hash passwords with a salt and manages cryptographic resources.

classes.name: PasswordHasher
classes.description: Implements password hashing using HMACSHA512. Provides methods for hashing passwords with salts and resource disposal.

methods.name: Hash
methods.description: Computes a hash for the given password concatenated with a salt using HMACSHA512.
